title: AI Optimists? AI Researchers Now Smoking Because Superintelligence Will Cure Cancer
dek: Because somewhere in Silicon Valley, a Marlboro is now a prayer.
note: On Sunday, Palantir’s chief technology officer told Margaret Brennan on Face the Nation that “so many AI researchers have started smoking” to signal how much they believe in AI. The logic: I’m so sure it will cure cancer, I’ll light up. Brennan said what everyone was thinking: “What? That makes no sense.” He named no researchers, and Fortune noted it’s unclear how many are smoking at all.

I went looking for what actually cures lung cancer, and it wasn’t a chatbot. The Annual Report to the Nation credits “accelerated progress against lung cancer,” and U.S. adult smoking hit an all-time low of 9% in 2025. Millions of boring people put the pack down. As far as I can tell, there is no AI cancer cure, only predictions. A prediction has never once shrunk a tumor.
